segments.oily: The one reviewer who names oily skin, alongside sensitive and acne-prone skin, says the balm works amazingly well for her as a double-cleanse step.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin consistently report the balm doesn't dry out their skin and several say it actively helps with dryness.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including some who are also acne-prone, report it cleans thoroughly while leaving their skin soft and neither stripped nor oily.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including some with rosacea, eczema, or rash-prone skin, consistently report no irritation or breakouts, with several saying it calmed redness that other cleansers had caused.

concerns.dehydration: Reviewers consistently report the balm cleans without drying out their skin or stripping its moisture, including several with dry skin; no reviewer in this set reports it left their skin feeling dry.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers report no eye irritation, with several specifically praising it as the rare balm that doesn't burn their eyes; a smaller group instead reports burning or irritated eyes when using it, including around eye makeup.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer describes using the balm to help recover from over a year of barrier damage from retinol overuse, reporting more moisturized, softer skin within a month and reduced irritation.
concerns.spots: The one reviewer who mentions hyperpigmentation and scars reports they began clearing up after switching to this balm as part of recovering her damaged skin barrier.
concerns.blemishes: A vocal minority reports new breakouts or pore-clogging, with a couple pointing to a specific ingredient as the likely cause; a much larger number, including several self-described acne-prone reviewers and one esthetician, report no breakouts or even fewer than before.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily skin reports good results overall; another reviewer notes the balm leaves skin a bit oily afterward and recommends following with a second cleanser.

I've been a super minimalist when it comes to skincare products for a long time. Most skincare products contain ingredients that cause more harm than good and I have sensitive, dry, redness prone skin. I had just been using various microfiber cleansing cloths and water as a cleanser for years, but decided to try this after having a good experience with another Good Molecules product and wanting to explore this brand. I am very impressed with this brand and have added several products to my rountine. I really like this cleanser, it does a great job of removing mineral makeup and tinted mineral sunscreen, it doesnt cause any irritation or dry out my skin at all. I use a small amount of cleanser (like a spoonful of the included spatula), so this tub will last a long time. The secret to using this though is to emulsify it while it's on the skin by applying it on dry skin and then adding a little water by wetting my fingers while cleansing. That way it cleans and rinses off completely. It is very gentle and does a better job of removing makeup and sunscreen than the cloths i had been using for years. I only use cleanser at night though to keep from overstripping my skin. I'm very impressed with this line and love their minimal ingredients, nonirritating, cruelty free products and amazing price point!

Before trying this cleanser, I had been dealing with repairing barrier damage from retinol overuse for 1 1/2 years. My skin had improved some but it was still too sensitive for even a hyaluronic acid serum, let alone anything stronger than that. I basically could only use gentle oils, occasional exfoliation with a soft cloth, gentle fragrance free sunscreen & moisturizer, and gentle cleanser with no active ingredients. I wasn't able to use any anti-aging or corrective products, I had worsened acne (and scars/hyperpigmentation that couldn't be treated) and my skin was losing its luster. The healing process was taking sooooo long, and I figured it might be another 1 1/2 years before it healed (or never). Then came this Good Molecules cleanser!! Within a month of using the cleansing balm, my skin looked more moisturized, it was softer, and any irritation was gone. Now, after about 4 months, I am able to safely use retinol once per week, and an alternating weekly face scrub with no adverse symptoms. My skin looks clearer, hyperpigmentation and scars are clearing up, my makeup looks WAY better, and I'm just so much less stressed about my skin. Seriously, this stuff is incredible—I wish I could hug the person who formulated it lol. Be sure to use it as instructed (don't wet your skin or hands before application). THANK YOU GOOD MOLECULES FOR SAVING MY SKIN🥹💖😍
